title: Giving feedback on speed limits and speed signs in NSW
summary: You can submit feedback about speed signs and speed limits in NSW to help prioritise road safety reviews.
intro:
The Centre for Road Safety uses feedback submitted by the public, along with crash data and other road safety engineering information, to prioritise the roads that need a speed zone review.

If you'd like to lodge feedback regarding speed signs and speed limits in NSW, you can complete an online form on the Centre for Road Safety website.

If they need further information, they may contact you using the details you've provided.
